compiler_observations.applicability: GInfer Muse consolidation source 196873072461d218e0f2ba5cf4a7c7c0a7b2ebd0; cross-build statements are compile evidence only

device_measurements.applicability: that physical RTX 5090 campaign run only
device_measurements.claim: On the campaign RTX 5090, retained Muse DFlash2 k4 C8 Program latency at 8K/request fell from 57.2176 to 42.0805 ms across the six accepted single-mechanism changes, a 26.46% reduction.

device_measurements.applicability: that physical RTX 5090 consolidation run only
